source_evidence: Exact player 'A lawful custodian? And here I thought I was to be the lord of this area. Who is in charge?' asks leader whose authority he claims and states expected lordship; no explicit identity/House disclosed or actual territorial claim adjudicated. Patrol leader becomes attentive, asks which House, says they serve Lady Caul, whose representatives administer road from old customs tower, claims hereditary charter predating present Crown; refers competing claim to tower administrator. These are the patrol's asserted authority and disclosed employer surname, not verified Crown appointment, legal charter validity, noble title, bloodline recognition, knowledge of private faction or identity beyond what was actually spoken. Existing prepared tower/road operation unchanged. Cirren and Mara note relevance of ancient charter to Silverward evidence; Mara quietly reminds V that conditional Silverward grant covers service-house/immediate grounds, not this road or surrounding district. Resident exemption still uninspected, goods and five NPC positions unchanged, no dues paid, attack, initiative, movement, seizure result, quest acceptance, roll or resources spent. Day333~11:32. V next decision.
